---
description: "Use when creating or editing shared UI components (Card, Gallery, ImageModal, Hyperlink) or adding new pages. Covers the page component pattern, the Card content container, Gallery thumbnail grid, ImageModal overlay, and the Hyperlink inline link with UrlString type."
applyTo: "src/components/Card.tsx, src/components/Gallery.tsx, src/components/ImageModal.tsx, src/components/Hyperlink.tsx, src/pages/**"
---

# Component patterns

- **Pages** (`src/pages/`): one default export per route, no props. Compose `Card`, `Gallery`, `ImageModal`, and page-specific sections. Pages set a root `<div className="page-<name>">` for page-scoped CSS.
- **Hub pages**: `src/pages/OtherPages.tsx` is the nav-visible entry point to the feature pages (`/live`, `/calendar`, `/gallery`) that deliberately have no nav slot. It renders one link-card per entry in its local `FEATURE_PAGES` array (`{ to, title, description, icon }`). WARNING: Because the features are off-nav, this array is the only in-nav path to them — a wrong `to` makes a page reachable only by typing the URL. Add a card whenever you add a non-nav feature page, and keep `src/test/pages/OtherPages.test.tsx` asserting each `href`. Note the card markup is a raw `<Link>` (not `Card`) so the whole tile is clickable; `Card`'s inner `<h3>` would otherwise need its own link.
- **Fleet status styling** (`src/pages/Fleet.tsx`): `VesselStatus` has three values (`Active`, `InDevelopment`, `Retired`) and `STATUS_STYLES` maps each to `{ text, dot, pulse }`. WARNING: Do **not** collapse this back to a two-way ternary on `status === "Active"` — that silently paints `Retired` the same amber as `InDevelopment`. `Retired` is deliberately muted (`text-black/60 dark:text-white/60`) and **does not pulse**, because the pulse reads as "live right now". WARNING: 60% is the floor, not a preference: 45% measures 3.27:1 against the page background and fails WCAG AA (4.5:1) at this text size. `src/test/pages/Fleet.test.tsx` guards both the colors and the pulse.
- **Sponsors** (`src/pages/Sponsors.tsx`): the `SPONSORS` array drives the card grid; `SponsorCard` is local to the file. Each entry is `{ name, logo?, website?, description? }`. Every card is a fixed `w-70` (280px) in a `flex-wrap` row, so the grid stays balanced as sponsors are added.
  - **`logo`** points at a file in `public/images/sponsors/` (e.g. `/images/sponsors/polymaker.svg`). It renders in a fixed-height (`h-36`) band that is **hard-coded `bg-white` in both themes** — deliberate, because sponsor logos are designed for light backgrounds. WARNING: Check that an incoming logo actually reads on white: Polymaker's is `#00C0C6` teal with no dark ink, so it does. A logo whose wordmark is white/very light will disappear. The img is `max-h-20 max-w-[75%]`, so very wide marks scale down (Polymaker's 425x93 renders 209x46).
  - **Sponsors without a `logo`** fall back to a `Landmark` icon in the same band. VT College of Engineering has no logo asset, so it uses the icon.
  - WARNING: Omitting `website` silently renders the name as plain text with no link — easy to miss.
  - WARNING: SVG logos are **not** touched by the `webp-convert` CI job, which globs only `public/images/*.png|jpg|jpeg` (single level, and raster-only). SVG logos are fine as-is.
  - `src/test/pages/Sponsors.test.tsx` guards the list, the link treatment, and the logo-vs-fallback split.
- **`Card`** (`src/components/Card.tsx`): the standard content container. Props: `as?: ElementType = "section"`, `className?`, `children?`, `id?`, `[key: string]: unknown` (spread to the rendered element). Renders `<h2>` title slot + children. Default width `w-[min(1100px,90%)]`. Used by Fleet, Sponsors, LiveMap panels. If you need a new content box, prefer `Card` over a bespoke container.
- **`Gallery`** (`src/components/Gallery.tsx`): responsive thumbnail grid. Props: `images: GalleryImage[]` (`{ src, alt, caption? }`), `onImageClick?: (image) => void`, `ariaLabel? = "Gallery"`. Grid: `grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr))] gap-3`. Renders a `<button>` wrapper when `onImageClick` is provided, else a bare `<img>`. All images are `loading="lazy"` with hover scale + shadow.
- **Gallery image data** (`src/lib/galleryImages.ts`): the single source of truth for photo data. `GALLERY_PHOTOS` (the loose `/images/gallery/*.webp` shots), `SUBTEAM_IMAGES` (keyed by the subteam `id`: `software`, `electronics`, `vehicle-dynamics`, `business`), and `ALL_GALLERY_IMAGES` (= loose photos first, then every subteam's, flattened).
  - WARNING: **The subteam photos appear in two places** — inline on Meet the Team (grouped per subteam) and mixed into the `/gallery` grid. Both pages import this module, so adding a photo means editing one file. Do not re-inline an image array into `OurTeam.tsx`.
  - WARNING: **`src` must be unique across the whole set.** The `/gallery` grid keys its tiles by `src`, so a duplicate silently drops a tile and emits a React duplicate-key warning. `src/test/lib/galleryImages.test.ts` guards this.
  - The `/gallery` page has its own tile markup (not the `Gallery` component) because it needs a `photo-container` class for the wider `max-w-275` grid and a 2-column mobile layout. It uses the same `ImageModal`, so captions from this module show in the lightbox.
  - WARNING: Neither gallery applies a hover color wash over the photos — tiles respond with a `scale-[1.04]` zoom and a drop shadow only. The `/gallery` tiles previously carried a maroon `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(134,31,65,0.35), transparent)` overlay, which tinted the bottom of every photo on hover; it was removed as unwanted. Don't reintroduce it.
  - `business` is intentionally `[]` — Meet the Team hides the gallery block for subteams with no photos.
  - WARNING: Team photos in `SUBTEAM_IMAGES` mostly have **real captions**; the loose `GALLERY_PHOTOS` only have `alt="#N"` placeholders. Prefer adding captions when adding team photos.
- **`ImageModal`** (`src/components/ImageModal.tsx`): full-screen overlay. Props: `src?`, `alt?`, `caption?`, `onClose: () => void`. Two-phase mount state (`mounted` + `isOpen`) so the enter/exit CSS transition plays. Focus management: stores `document.activeElement` on open, focuses the close button, restores focus on unmount. Closes on Escape key or backdrop click. `role="dialog"` `aria-modal="true"` `aria-label="Image preview"`.
- **`Hyperlink`** (`src/components/Hyperlink.tsx`): reusable inline link with a branded `UrlString` type. Props: `href: UrlString`, `children: ReactNode`, `hash?`, `className?`, `space?: "before"|"after"|"around"|"both"|"none"`. Internal paths (starting with `/`) render as a react-router `<Link>`; external URLs render as `<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">` with an sr-only "opens in a new tab" span. Construct `UrlString` via the exported `url(s)` helper (validates with `new URL()`, accepts bare paths like `/ourteam`). The `space` prop inserts surrounding whitespace so you don't need `{" "}` in JSX.

# React 19 notes

- React 19 supports the `fetchPriority` prop on `<img>` (React 18 did not — it caused a console warning). The codebase uses `fetchPriority="high"` on the site logo in `Header.tsx` and conditionally on hero images in `Fleet.tsx`.
- Components using `<Link>` from `react-router-dom` must be wrapped in `<MemoryRouter>` in tests.
